question: A man sold two tables for ₹ 720 each. On one he gained 20% and on the other he lost 20%. Find his total loss or gain in this transaction.
solution:
**Given:**

SP₁ = Rs. 720 and SP₂ = Rs. 720

Profit % = 20% and Loss % = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Profit % = (SP - CP)/(CP) times 100

Loss % = (CP - SP)/(CP) times 100

Loss = CP - SP

**Calculation:**

SP1 = Rs. 720

Profit % = (SP₁ - CP₁)/(CP₁) times 100

20 = (720 - CP₁)/(CP₁) times 100

CP₁ = 3600 - 5CP₁
